residual_definition: r = f - y, prediction minus target, on the 41x41 grid flattened in C order (1681 values per sample); predictions are the reflection-averaged arrays the campaign scored
dtype: float16, little-endian ('<f2'); hashes are sha256 of the C-order bytes
test_block: samples 20000..39999 of the distributed file, fixed for every seed
val_split: n_val=1000 drawn from samples 0..19999 by common.canonical_split with NMKC_SPLIT_SEED equal to the seed; idx_val in each file
